stories.ltme_summary: Phil Rosen has filed Rosen v. Pichai, a shareholder derivative suit against Google chief executive Sundar Pichai and other officers and directors, including Larry Page, Sergey Brin, John Hennessy, John Doerr and Kent Walker. The suit adds a BIPA claim to copyright allegations, following a similar Rosen suit against Apple.
stories.hook: Rosen v. Pichai adds a BIPA claim to a copyright shareholder derivative suit against Google's leadership
